gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9002 mounted lenses, filters and other optical elements; 9001 unmounted elements considered

rejected_alternatives.reason: unmounted optical elements; H81010 used this for an unmounted photographic filter, applies if the filter has no mount

missing_facts: whether the filter is mounted (in a frame or ring) or an unmounted glass disc
classification.rationale: Heading 9002 covers mounted filters with a specific photographic line. H81010 placed an unmounted photographic filter in 9001.90.90; the description here says nothing about mounting, so the named photographic filter line is assumed for a finished filter.
